why: 429 test files (107,860 lines) are the real regression suite. Without a per-file disposition, ports are skipped or retired by accident, and one shared JSON would conflict across parallel leads.
what: New: tools/migrate-v3/ledger/<area>.json (one file per area, non-package), packages/basalt-ui/scripts/check-test-ledger.ts with test, and packages/basalt-ui/src/testing/render-app.tsx with test (a seed). The one edit outside owns is one line wiring the check into the root Makefile check target, as its own non-package commit.
contract: docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md section 8 (buckets, port order, 'Ledger, one file per area'), section 9.2.
exemplar: packages/basalt-ui/scripts/check-agent-doc-drift.ts and its test (a gate script reading repo files, 2.x).
change: Ledger rows: file, area, disposition (port, audit, retire, swap, retarget, rewrite), target path or null, laws (the digest section 3 invariant it pins), status open or closed per area. The file list comes from the 2.x tree (git ls-tree -r on branch v2 filtered to test files; record the command). check-test-ledger unions the area files: every 2.x test file named once, retire cites a kill-list item or a migration row, port and retarget targets must exist once an area is closed, laws names an invariant; --report prints bucket totals for the PR to compare with the section 8 table (115 port, 12 audit, 23 retire, 29 swap, 35 charts retarget, 50 composites retarget, 4 audit and 18 retire in the second block, 62 rewrite, 81 layout) and to explain any difference. renderApp(ui, options?) is a seed: wraps in the v3 provider when it exists, applies the scheme option to data-theme, UTC time zone, cleanup; settled() and the SSR harness are v3-qa-i3's. Rule: none. Skill snippet: none. Test: check-test-ledger.test.ts, render-app.test.tsx.
commits: One PR, rebase-merged. Commit 1 (package): check-test-ledger and render-app. Commit 2 (non-package): tools/migrate-v3/ledger/*.json and the one-line Makefile wiring. Conventional, empty scope, no attribution. Never edit CHANGELOG.md.
proof: Gate script run plus its tests.
